## Body

The prime set it on 2026-11-06 23:13: in pij-fleet's community the compaction line is 400k, not the PA brief's 600k default. Compact over-400k seats that are working or will be needed again, at their next boundary, after their memory turn (handshake: handover file under roles/<role>/outputs/handover-<seat>-<date>.md, reply 'handover ready', then pij send <seat> --command compact). Context comes from the Copilot footer (ctx is ? in the nudge). The cold-seat rule still applies. First cases: pij-local-warbler (656k then 731k, long turn) and pij-steady-otter (552k).
